title: Information Interchange on 3.81 mm Magnetic Tape Cassette at 4 cpmm, Phase Encoded at 63 ftpmm
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12876) covers Information Interchange on 3.81 mm Magnetic Tape Cassette at 4 cpmm, Phase Encoded at 63 ftpmm. This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 3407:1983 Information processing — Information interchange on 381 mm ( 01 50 in ) magnetic tape cassette at 4 cpmm ( lOOcpi ), phase encoded at 63 ftpmm ( 1 600 ftpi )', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the recommendation of the Computers, Business Machines and Calculators Sectional Committee ( LTDC 24 ) and approval of the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards; attention is specially drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. b) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use point ( . ) ^^ the decimal marker. c) For the purpose of Indian Standard, metric dimensions are applicable.
